usedFor: Cancelled Shopify orders go to Decision Maker for a yes/no, choice or score.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Cancelled” in Shopify, then “Decision Maker” in Decision Maker
bestTemplate.why: A cancellation needs a call, and the confidence value lets you route refunds apart from mistakes.

watchOut: “Decision Maker” only returns a decision and confidence value, so any follow-up action is a separate step.
